newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand tourist arrivals up 4.31 pct.
newsitem.headline: Thailand tourist arrivals up 4.31 pct.

text.p: The number of tourists visiting Thailand during the first half of 1996 rose 4.31 percent over the same period last year, the state-run Tourism Authority of Thailand said in a statement on Monday.
A total of 3,531,342 tourists visited Thailand during the first six months of this year compared with 3,385,385 tourists last year, it said.
The highest number of tourists came from neighbouring Malaysia. Visitors from Russia showed the biggest percentage increase of 32 percent compared with the same period last year.

The total number of East Europeans visiting Thailand between January and June was 15,879, up 5.44 percent from the same period last year. The rise was due to increased flights from Eastern Europe and the improving economies of countries there, the authority said.
